textos.Dirigido por Brady Corbet, o drama O Bru: Directed by Brady Corbet, the drama The Brutalist (2024) follows the journey of a visionary architect who flees Europe in the postwar period to rebuild his life, career and marriage in America. Alone in a strange country, he seeks to start over by settling in Pennsylvania, where his singular talent is recognized by a rich, prominent industrialist.
